question: How does abstaining from food by day lead to overcoming death from aging?
premises: A regimen of not eating by day is prescribed.
This practice leads to going beyond that death.
inference: Through daytime abstention from food, one will overcome death caused by aging.
uncertainties: the exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may mean reaching or transcending death
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death from aging.
